description: Use this when the user asks which companies recently started, stopped or switched using a technology, for example companies that left Intercom or adopted HubSpot: set moved_from or moved_to. Also covers growth and hiring changes. Newest first. Changes are recorded as each site is re-crawled, so an empty result means none recorded yet, not that none happened. Works without an API key; no contact reveals.

days.description: Only signals detected in the last N days

sector.description: Industry sector, exact label from the list

size.description: Estimate, not headcount: a band by how many people and addresses we found on the company's own website: micro (1-5), small (6-20), medium (21-60), large (61+). Large companies often publish few, so do not use it to exclude them.

type.description: Signal type; omit for all technology signals

name: get_signals
title: Switch signals
